verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs make qualitative speed claims, such as context() 'returns instantly' and being 'efficient enough to use at every turn'. The evidence contains no documented latency targets, benchmarks or measured p50/p95 numbers backing those claims. Token-budget savings concern context size, not retrieval latency.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
